args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, and v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully and the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. (The first API call returned a 502, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was created and is open.)
